bear.name: Bear
bear.description: A powerful woodland omnivore, dangerous when its young or feeding ground are threatened.

source.notes: Uses the existing claws and fur profiles and executable Smash action. Kyr rolls its attributes; the Deem animal grammar composes the body.

provenanceLedger.note: Retains claws, fur and a defensive disposition. Kyr rolls scores, uses a 12-point hit die and the existing executable Smash action; the original animal stat line is not transcribed.
